tutorial.1: At the beginning of the game, you'll be given some cards.
tutorial.2:
Tick the box next to their name to lock them in.
Also tick any public card.
tutorial.3: Once you've locked in all your cards, tap the lock icon in your toolbar.
tutorial.4: Your game progress is saved automatically.
tutorial.hp: On the Harry Potter board, keep track of how much dust you have with this counter. Tap it to increase and decrease how much dust you have.
tutorial.5: Assistant lets you keep track of your opponents' guesses.
tutorial.6: If you make a mistake, you can undo and redo. Your actions are saved with the game. View your action history by long pressing (or right-clicking) on one of the buttons.
tutorial.infoPanel: You can get detailed player information by tapping their name.
